description:
Shared exception-signaling primitives and metadata attributes used throughout the IVSoftware Portable suite.
			Provides controlled Throw/Advisory pathways and caller-aware diagnostics suitable for Release-mode packages.
releaseNotes:
1.1.2-rc
			- Exclude dynamic assemblies from initial TypeCache discovery, later
			  AssemblyLoad notifications, and explicit namespace append.
			- Avoid unsupported exported-type reflection during Android LINQ
			  expression compilation without suppressing debugger diagnostics.
			- Add regression coverage for dynamic assemblies before discovery,
			  late loads, namespace append, and expression compilation.
			- Preserve the public API and netstandard2.0 target.

			1.1.2-beta
			- Removed the redundant net8.0 asset; netstandard2.0 remains available
			  to compatible consumers, including .NET 8. No public API changes.
			- Added Barcode.NewBarcode() and Barcode.Create(DateTimeOffset) for
			  optional, infrequently generated physical-item label payloads.
			- Added BarcodeFormat.UtcTimestamp (default: yyMMdd-HHmm-AAAA) and
			  BarcodeFormat.RandomLetters (AAAAAA-AAAA-AAAA), both 16 characters.
			- Uses cryptographic randomness with unbiased letter sampling;
			  uniqueness is probabilistic, not guaranteed. Generate once and
			  persist the payload for reuse. Barcode/QR rendering is consumer-owned.
			- Added eight focused barcode tests and an opt-in direct MSTest runner.
			- Clarified ToStrongNamedFriendAssembly as a development-time annotation
			  helper. Its existing Type/unsigned-assembly diagnostics are returned
			  strings outside the Throw/Advisory stream; no helper behavior changed
			  in this release.

			1.1.x
			- Added enum-driven policy throwing with PolicyAttribute,
			  PolicyEnforcementAttribute, and ThrowPolicyException.
			- Added PolicyError to Throw so consumers can pattern match on
			  the originating enum member.
			- Added PublishedContractAttribute, NotFlagsAttribute, and
			  ClaimAttribute.
			- Added Win32Message and ToStrongNamedFriendAssembly(this object).
			- Added AppDomain TypeCache baseline functionality.
title: IVSoftware.Portable.Common
